t: Automating SEO Data Integration and Truncation for ML Clustering
s: This article details the process of unifying diverse SEO data sources (SEMRush, Botify) into a single DataFrame and strategically truncating it by search volume. This preparation is crucial for efficient and meaningful ML-driven keyword clustering, filtering out irrelevant long-tail data.
sub: Grand Unification of SEO data sources (SEMRush, Botify)
Strategic data truncation by search volume
Preparation for Machine Learning keyword clustering
Pipulate integration of data processing logic
